verdict.rationale: GitBook documents a block-based visual editor with custom blocks and Markdown support, plus Git sync. That points to rich, component-style authoring without hand-written HTML, and the updates block is one concrete example. Community users praise its Markdown support and web editor. The specific components named in the story are never evidenced, and MDX is not mentioned. missing for 10: explicit evidence of tabs, callouts/hints, code groups and steps blocks, MDX support, documentation of the Markdown syntax for blocks when synced from Git, independent hands-on corroboration of component authoring.
